name: stint
description: Run your agent in stints. Pit before the redline.

dash.title: stint · Dash
dash.description: The instruments band above the prompt (revs, fuel, stint, board) and the zone toasts; the status line carries it where there is no band. full: with emoji. ascii: ASCII-only, no hex colours, for terminals that misjudge emoji width. off: no band; the pit lines stay.

autopit.title: stint · Auto-pit
autopit.description: Pit by itself, in two cases. Idle trigger: the session sits idle for 50 min (before the 1 h prompt cache expires) with 80k tokens or more of context. Ceiling trigger: right after a turn, when the context is at 80% of the window or more (or 90% of the point where the host compacts on its own, if that comes first). Both skip when a draft is in the prompt box or an agent is busy. The fresh session opens with one line (when, why, how big, where the notes are), a short summary, then waits for you. on: both triggers. off: never.

checkpoint.title: stint · Checkpoint
checkpoint.description: Checkpoint trailers. stint teaches the model to end a turn that settles a decision with one <!-- ckpt ... --> comment, writes each one to .stint/<stream>-journal.md and hides it on screen behind a marker (pressable in fullscreen). on: all of it. off: none of it: no rule sent to the model, no journal, no hiding. The rule already sent stays in the current conversation until /clear or /compact.

debug.title: stint · Debug
debug.description: Trace the pit steps (metadata only: paths, sizes, ids) in the plugin store and the debug log. If the notes are not re-injected after a /pit, a report is written to .stint/debug-<time>.md in the folder of the pit. /pit --trace writes the trace on demand. off: nothing is recorded.
